title: The Challenges of Selling Into Manufacturing
html:
And How Those Challenges Meet Their Match with MarketJoy 

Selling automation into the manufacturing industry can come
with some tough challenges fierce competition, hard-to-reach
decision-makers, and long sales cycles. Add to this,
manufacturing is a huge and hugely diverse “umbrella” industry,
from OEMs to auto manufacturers to CPG goods and more. A
one-size-fits-all B2B marketing strategy simply won’t get the job done for anyone with a clear vision and goals.

One of MarketJoy’s chief specialties is helping companies that
solve manufacturing problems through new automation solutions
and services find their ideal target audience through rigorous
data research and connect with that audience using winning messaging that has been methodically tested for traction.
